title: Evidence Of Dark Energy
definition: Dark Energy is a hypothetical, pervasive form of energy that exerts a negative pressure, acting as a repulsive force to drive the accelerated expansion of the universe. It constitutes approximately 68-70% of the total mass-energy density of the cosmos.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Science & Tech (Space Physics) due to its role in the Standard Cosmological Model (Lambda-CDM) and its connection to major international space missions like Euclid and James Webb.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Evidence Of Dark Energy.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
